note: Trusted third-party server plugins around SÜLD. SÜLD owns gameplay (classes, EXP, skills, combat, items, quests, dungeons, relics, HUD, Kharkhorum, /help, /spawn); these provide generic server plumbing. Never add plugins that own RPG/UI layers (MythicMobs, MMOCore, MMOItems, mcMMO, Jobs, Citizens, ItemsAdder, Oraxen, DeluxeMenus, TAB, BetterHud). Profiles: core = always (test + production), hardening = production, optional = on request, dev = admin/build tools only. Exactly one of each conflicting pair is installed.
